title: Getting started with sdmApp
text: sdmApp R package containing Shiny application lets non-expert R users model species distribution. brings reproducible workflow species distribution modeling single, user friendly environment. sdmApp takes raster data (format supported raster package) species occurrence data (several formats supported) input, provides interactive graphical user interface (GUI). vignette two parts. first shows small set mapping helpers sdmApp exports, using example data bundled package, can reproduce every figure machine. second describes graphical interface data expects. main features GUI : uploading data (raster predictors species occurrence files); viewing correlation raster predictors; using CENFA select species predictors; applying spatial blocking cross-validation, based blockCV package; fitting species distribution models without spatial blocking strategy; exporting results; staying reproducible downloading underlying R code. GUI built around five main windows, selectable navigation bar top screen. windows start empty fill raster species occurrence data uploaded.

text: sdmApp currently CRAN, install GitHub. CENFA also CRAN must installed first. use MaxEnt model additionally need Java JDK (>= 8), rJava package, maxent.jar file placed java directory dismo package, can locate : Everything shown vignette works without Java.

text: Two water productivity variables retrieved FAO WaPOR database. Net biomass water productivity (NBWP) expresses total biomass production relation volume water beneficially consumed canopy transpiration year, net soil evaporation. Actual evapotranspiration interception (AETI) sum soil evaporation, canopy transpiration interception, rainfall intercepted leaves evaporated directly surface (FAO, 2020). agrometeorological variables useful monitoring effectively vegetation converts water biomass (NBWP) analysing soil-air interface plant functioning (AETI).

title: Getting started with sdmApp
text: Random splits spatially structured data give -optimistic error estimates (Telford Birks, 2009; Roberts et al., 2017). sdmApp relies blockCV build spatially separated folds, sdmApp_fold_Explorer() draws training testing points chosen fold top background raster. Note compatibility caveat. blockCV version 3.0, spatialBlock() deprecated favour cv_spatial(), object returned cv_spatial() longer class SpatialBlock. sdmApp_fold_Explorer() currently tests class, works deprecated spatialBlock() yet cv_spatial(). Support new class planned.
code: library(blockCV)  sb <- spatialBlock(   speciesData = pa_data["Faidherbia.albida"],   species = "Faidherbia.albida",   rasterLayer = r,   theRange = 2000,   k = 5,   selection = "random",   iteration = 100 )  sdmApp_fold_Explorer(sb, r, pa_data["Faidherbia.albida"], num = 1)

what: A typical session in the GUI
title: Getting started with sdmApp
text: navigation bar exposes five tabs, meant visited order. Help/gives short description application modelling options. Data Upload takes raster predictors species occurrence file. Occurrence data can supplied CSV, Excel, Stata, SPSS SAS. Nothing else interface populated step succeeds. Spatial Analysis covers predictor screening. can inspect correlation matrix predictors, run ecological niche factor analysis CENFA rank predictors contribution marginality specialisation, estimate range spatial autocorrelation, build spatial blocks cross-validation. Modeling fits models. Bioclim, Domain, Mahalanobis, GLM, MaxEnt, random forest support vector machines available, without spatial blocking strategy, results can exported rasters tables. R-Code returns R code corresponding session, analysis can rerun, version controlled shared. reasonable workflow therefore: upload, drop strongly correlated predictors, select predictors CENFA, choose block size informed spatial autocorrelation range, generate folds, fit one models, compare , export maps R code.

title: sdmApp 0.0.3
text: Dropped archived rgdal rgeos dependencies. sdmApp now relies raster (>= 3.6.3), reaches GDAL, GEOS PROJ terra, package installs current R. Reworked DESCRIPTION: packages actually used exported functions moved Imports; modelling engines used inside shiny interface stay Suggests checked launch. NAMESPACE now generated roxygen2 targeted @importFrom tags instead blanket exportPattern() long @import lists.

title: sdmApp 0.0.3
text: sdmApp() longer calls recursively builds shiny app . validates theme maxRequestSize front stops informative message listing missing suggested packages. Replaced deprecated ggplot2::aes_string() aes() .data[[ ]] across mapping helpers. Replaced guides(fill = FALSE) guides(fill = "none"). Replaced fragile class(x) == "SpatialBlock" comparisons inherits(). Added input validation sdmApp_PA(), sdmApp_RasterPlot(), sdmApp_TimesRasters() sdmApp_fold_Explorer().
